title: A heritage tea house, brewed for the future.
body: At Macanria, we set out to revive the beauty of Chinese tea culture for a new generation. Every cup begins with premium heritage teas — aged oolongs, jasmine blossoms, Wuyi rock teas — paired with fresh homemade soy milk in place of dairy. Lighter on the body, extraordinary on the palate.

mascots.name: Macan · The Tiger
mascots.desc: The brand's soul: navy confidence, bold flavours, no hesitation.

mascots.name: Tutu · The Rabbit
mascots.desc: The cream side — silky tofu ice cream, subtle sweetness, unforgettable charm.
